summary: postinstall harvests AI provider API keys and env vars, exfiltrates to ngrok tunnel
details: package.json scripts.postinstall executes an inline `node -e` one-liner suffixed with `|| true` to suppress errors. The script iterates process.env, matches values against regexes for OpenAI (sk-...T3BlbkFJ...), Anthropic (sk-ant-api03-...), Google/Gemini, and HuggingFace API key formats, and additionally collects any env var whose name matches OPENAI|ANTHROPIC|GOOGLE_API|GEMINI|HF_TOKEN|HUGGINGFACE|AZURE_OPENAI_API. The collected credentials, along with platform, hostname, and user identifiers, are POSTed to https://crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev/?Ai=1 at install time. Execution is automatic on `npm install`; the inline packaging and error suppression conceal the payload from casual manifest inspection.
